nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared icon library exporting 17 lightweight SVG icon components (close, search, filter, plus, trash, chevrons, photo, spinner, edit, map pin, calendar, ellipsis, pencil, camera, list) reused across the frontend UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Each icon is a small stateless functional component accepting a className prop; individual icon components are omitted from the graph as trivial SVG boilerplate.
